Operator:
Good day, and welcome to the CloudScale Solutions Q3 2023 Earnings Conference Call. All participants are in listen-only mode. After the speakers' presentation, there will be a question and answer session. [Operator Instructions] Please be advised that today's call is being recorded.

I would now like to turn the call over to Sarah Miller, Investor Relations Manager. Please go ahead.

Sarah Miller:
Thank you, Operator. Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome to CloudScale Solutions' Q3 2023 earnings call. Joining me today are Alex Johnson, CEO; Emily Carter, CFO; David Lee, CTO; and Michael Brown, Chief Revenue Officer.

Before we begin, I'd like to remind you that this call contains forward-looking statements. Actual results may differ materially. Please refer to our SEC filings for a complete discussion of risks and uncertainties.

Now, I'll turn the call over to Alex Johnson.

Alex Johnson:
Thank you, Sarah, and good afternoon, everyone. I'm pleased to report on CloudScale Solutions' performance for Q3 2023. We achieved significant milestones this quarter, driven by strong demand for our SynergyOS platform and continued execution of our strategic initiatives.

Our focus this quarter was on five key areas: optimizing our cost structure, improving sales efficiency, validating the assumptions underlying our guidance, increasing average contract value, and expanding revenue from our existing customer base.

We are committed to continuously optimizing our Cost of Revenue and improving our gross margin. The initiatives we've outlined, including cloud infrastructure optimization, process automation, and strategic vendor negotiations, are all designed to achieve this goal. We are actively working to optimize our sales efficiency, focusing specifically on sales cycle length and conversion rates. We've been actively working to optimize them and saw slight improvements this quarter. We want to provide a detailed understanding of the factors driving our projections for the next quarter and the full fiscal year, so will touch on our key assumptions. We are pleased to report continued positive trends in our Average Contract Value. In Q4 2023, our ACV reached $45,000, representing a 7% increase year-over-year, and we will discuss the drivers. Expansion Revenue is a critical driver of our continued success. This is revenue generated from our existing customer base, and it\u2019s a key indicator of our value proposition, customer satisfaction, and long-term growth potential.

We are confident in our ability to continue this momentum and deliver long-term value to our shareholders.

Now, I'll turn the call over to Emily Carter to discuss the financials in more detail.

Emily Carter:
Thank you, Alex. As Alex mentioned, we had a strong quarter. Revenue for the quarter was $150 million, representing a 22% increase year-over-year. Our gross margin was 72%, and operating income was $30 million.

We continue to invest in research and development to drive innovation and expand our product offerings. Our cash position remains strong, providing us with the flexibility to pursue strategic acquisitions and other growth opportunities.

We are updating our full-year guidance to reflect our strong performance in the first half of the year. We now expect revenue to be in the range of $610 million to $620 million.

Now, I'll turn the call over to David Lee for a technology update.

David Lee:
Thank you, Emily. This quarter, we made significant progress in advancing our AI capabilities and further integrating them into our core platform. We are seeing strong adoption of our new AI-powered features, which are driving increased user engagement and improved customer outcomes. We've also focused on enhancing our platform's security and scalability to meet the growing demands of our enterprise customers.

Now, I'll turn the call back to the operator for Q&A.

Operator:
Thank you. [Operator Instructions] Our first question comes from Johnathan Meyers with Goldman Sachs.

Johnathan Meyers:
Hi, good afternoon. Can you discuss the impact of the Pro package on your overall growth, and what kind of attach rates are you seeing with it?

Michael Brown:
We saw significant traction with our enterprise-level Pro package, an upgrade from our standard offering. The Pro package, which includes advanced analytics, dedicated support, and enhanced security features, saw a 35% conversion rate among our standard users. Furthermore, cross-selling our project management module to existing CRM users contributed a significant portion of the expansion. We've seen a 22% adoption rate within our CRM customer base, demonstrating the synergy between our product offerings.

Operator:
Our next question comes from Susan Patel with Morgan Stanley.

Susan Patel:
What are your plans for international expansion, specifically in the APAC region?

Alex Johnson:
We are seeing strong growth in the APAC region, particularly in Southeast Asia. We are investing in expanding our sales and marketing presence in this region and tailoring our product offerings to meet the specific needs of local markets. We are focusing on building partnerships with local resellers and system integrators to expand our reach and improve our understanding of the local market.

Operator:
Our next question comes from Mark Thompson with JP Morgan.

Mark Thompson:
How are you managing churn in the current economic environment, and what's the trend you are seeing in NRR?

Emily Carter:
We've made significant strides in reducing churn among our existing customers. Our Q3 churn rate was down to 4.5%, a marked improvement from 5.2% in the same quarter last year. We are now proactively engaging with customers who exhibit signs of potential churn, offering customized solutions and support to address their specific needs, and have invested in a new customer success platform. We are targeting an NDR of 122% for SynergyOS for the full fiscal year.

Operator:
Thank you. I'm showing no further questions at this time. I'd like to turn the call back over to Alex Johnson for closing remarks.

Alex Johnson:
Thank you for joining us today. We are pleased with our progress this quarter and remain committed to delivering strong results for our shareholders. We look forward to speaking with you again on our next earnings call.

Operator:
Thank you for your participation. You may now disconnect.
